import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize categorical labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace('nan', pd.NA)
    # Convert numeric-like columns to numbers
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Remove out-of-range body masses
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
